keys.manual_legacy.toc.title: Table of Contents
keys.manual_legacy.cta.title: Ready to Present!
keys.manual_legacy.cta.text: Now you have all the knowledge you need to be an excellent XIRO presenter!
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s1.title: Open presenter.html
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s1.text: Go to xiro.pro and tap «Presenter». The game selection screen loads automatically. Activate full screen (F11) before starting if you are projecting.
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s2.title: Select the game
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s2.text: Browse the tabs: Custom Games, Mixes, Banks or Trivial. Tap the card of the game you want to present.
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s3.title: Choose the game mode
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s3.text: Choose between Individual (each player competes alone) or Teams (points are pooled per team). Teams are assigned from the lobby settings.
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s4.title: Lobby — Wait for players
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s4.text: The session ID and QR code appear on screen. Players join from xiro.pro. The «START!» button activates as soon as at least one player is connected.
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s5.title: Press «START!» and run the game
keys.manual_presenter.qs.s5.text: A countdown (3, 2, 1…) appears and the first question begins. Your only control is the «Next» button to advance: question → result → ranking → next question.
keys.manual_presenter.ctrl.fullscreen.title: Full screen
keys.manual_presenter.ctrl.fullscreen.text: Button in the top-right corner. Activate it when projecting on a large screen. You can also use F11 in most browsers.
keys.manual_presenter.ctrl.timer.title: Timer
keys.manual_presenter.ctrl.timer.text: Appears in the top centre during each question. Click on it to pause or resume. In the last 5 seconds it changes colour. The state syncs with all players.
keys.manual_presenter.ctrl.next.title: «Next» button
keys.manual_presenter.ctrl.next.text: Appears in the bottom-right corner when time runs out or after showing the explanation. Read its dynamic text: «Next Question» if more remain or «See Ranking» on the last one.
keys.manual_presenter.ctrl.manual_pts.title: Manual points
keys.manual_presenter.ctrl.manual_pts.text: Only available on comment slides. A grid with all players and buttons +1, +5 and +10 appears. Use it to reward oral participation or open answers.
keys.manual_presenter.game.text_q.title: Text question
keys.manual_presenter.game.text_q.text: Displays the question in large text, the coloured options, the timer and a counter of how many players have already answered. Wait for everyone to answer or for the time to run out.
keys.manual_presenter.game.img_q.title: Image question
keys.manual_presenter.game.img_q.text: The image is projected in large. The answer options are NOT shown on the presenter's screen to avoid spoilers. Players see them on their devices.
keys.manual_presenter.game.audio_q.title: Audio question
keys.manual_presenter.game.audio_q.text: The audio plays automatically when the question is shown and loops until the time runs out. If the browser blocks it, click on the screen to activate it.
keys.manual_presenter.game.info_slide.title: Info slide
keys.manual_presenter.game.info_slide.text: No timer or answers. Used to explain concepts or show context. Press «Next» when you have finished your explanation.
keys.manual_presenter.game.comment_slide.text: Pauses the game for interaction. You can pose an open question or debate and then assign points manually using the +1, +5, +10 buttons. Press «Next» when done.
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.intro.title: What is Trivia Mode?
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.intro.text: XIRO! becomes a Trivial Pursuit-style board game. Players move pieces on a circular board answering category questions. The first to collect the token of each category wins.
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.board.title: The board
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.board.text:
Outer ring: colour-coded squares by category. The HQ squares ✦ are the only ones where you can win a token.
Spokes: 5 squares connecting the ring to the centre.
Centre: starting point.
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.turn.title: Player's turn
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.turn.text: The active player rolls the 3D die from their phone. The squares they can move to light up on the board. The player chooses a square, receives the category question and answers.
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.tokens.title: Tokens and winning
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.tokens.text:
Correct on HQ ✦: wins the token and rolls again.
Regular correct: stays on the square and rolls again.
Wrong: turn passes. First to complete all tokens wins.
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.setup.title: Set up from Admin
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.setup.text: Go to Admin → Trivial → New Trivial. Define the name, 2 to 6 categories with colour and question source (bank, mix or custom game). A source in use cannot be deleted.
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.tips.title: Tips for the presenter
keys.manual_presenter.trivial.tips.text: Keep the board projected so everyone can follow. Remind players that ✦ squares award tokens. Use team mode with large groups. With 2–3 categories the game is quicker.
